author: Muhammad Zulhusni
description:
Microsoft is adding more AI agents to its workplace tools, alongside updates for Copilot, Windows, Foundry, and new device prototypes. The announcements, made at the Build developer conference in San Francisco, covered Copilot agents, Project Solara prototypes, Nvidia-powered developer machines, OpenClaw controls for Windows, and new models from Microsoft’s AI unit.
